protocol.title: A Digital Microfluidic Platform for Human Plasma Protein Depletion
protocol.source: M.Sc. Thesis, Queen's University, Kingston, Ontario, Canada, May 2014
protocol.platform: Two-plate digital microfluidics (DMF) on glass chip with automated magnetic separation
protocol.objective: Automated on-chip depletion of high-abundance plasma proteins (HSA and IgG) using paramagnetic bead-based immunocapture on a DMF device, with downstream MALDI-MS and LC-MS/MS characterisation of the depleted proteome

device.fabrication_facility: University of Toronto Nanofabrication Centre (TNFC) clean room

magnet.control: Automated via custom Microdrop software + Pogo-pin interface

device.incubation_pattern: Figure-8 across 4 electrodes for continuous droplet mixing

HSA.source: Lyophilized solid, Life Technologies (Carlsbad, CA), reconstituted in PBS

hemopexin.source: Lyophilized solid, Life Technologies (Carlsbad, CA), reconstituted in PBS

ProteinAG_Beads.product: PureProteome Protein A/G Mix Magnetic Beads
ProteinAG_Beads.coating: Mix of Protein A and Protein G

PBS_Buffer.use: Bead dilution, wash, and droplet carrier

PluronicF68.role: On-chip droplet stability; prevents non-specific protein adsorption
PluronicF68.selection_note: Selected in Chapter 3 screening. Pluronic F-127 and L64 inhibited bead-protein binding. L92, F68, and F88 did not interfere; F68 gave best droplet movement on DMF chip.

steps.name: Reagent preparation and device loading
steps.notes: Beads pre-diluted off-chip in PBS (Protein A/G 1:4; anti-HSA 1:2). Protein sample prepared as 2 mg/mL IgG + 0.5 mg/mL HSA + 0.1 mg/mL hemopexin in PBS + 0.05% Pluronic F-68. One 4 uL droplet each of beads and sample loaded into reservoirs by pipette. Both bead types combined into a single mixed-bead suspension for simultaneous dual depletion.

steps.name: Bead actuation onto device array
steps.notes: Mixed bead droplet actuated from reservoir into active electrode array. Beads remain suspended during transfer.

steps.name: Magnet engagement -- bead immobilization (first)
steps.notes: Motor-controlled magnet positioned below chip. Paramagnetic beads pelleted onto device surface. heat at 25c is a BioScript abstraction for the immobilization dwell time.

steps.name: Supernatant removal and PBS wash
steps.notes: Bead storage buffer removed by DMF actuation to waste reservoir; wicked off with KimWipes. Fresh PBS wash droplet added and mixed briefly; magnet re-engaged (30s dwell) to re-pellet beads before sample addition.

steps.name: Protein sample merge with bead pellet
steps.notes: Sample droplet actuated over immobilized beads; magnet disengaged to resuspend beads. Combined droplet contains IgG (2 mg/mL), HSA (0.5 mg/mL), hemopexin (0.1 mg/mL), 0.05% Pluronic F-68, Protein A/G beads, and anti-HSA beads.

steps.name: Active incubation -- figure-8 mixing

depletion_efficiency_pct.method: Fluorescence intensity (FITC-IgG / FITC-HSA) normalized to pre-depletion control

steps.notes: Continuous droplet movement ensures particle dispersal and maximizes antibody-antigen contact. Four simultaneous samples processed in parallel on device.

steps.name: Bead re-immobilization and supernatant separation
steps.notes: Magnet re-engaged. Beads (carrying captured IgG and HSA) pelleted. Depleted supernatant (retaining hemopexin) actuated to collection reservoir by DMF electrode switching.

steps.name: Depleted sample collection and QC detection
steps.notes: Depleted protein sample collected in reservoir. Top plate removed off-chip; droplet transferred by pipette for downstream analysis. QC gate determines depletion success.

steps.name: Fluorescence kinetics characterisation (FITC-IgG)
steps.operation: mix + heat 30s intervals + detect fluorescenceDetection for 30s

plate_reader.instrument: PHERAstar microplate reader (BMG Labtech, Ortenberg, Germany)

hsA_variant.note: Identical protocol; encoded separately in kinetics branch comments

steps.bioscript_note: BioScript has no loop construct; 20 x 30s intervals abstracted as one representative kinetics step with a single 30s heat + detect. Full iterative kinetics performed off-chip.

maldi_ms.instrument: PerSeptive Biosystems Voyager DE Pro MALDI-TOF (AB Sciex, Framingham, MA)

matrix.protein_depletion: Sinapinic acid (SA): 10 mg/mL in 50% ACN / 0.1% TFA
matrix.tryptic_digest: alpha-cyano-4-hydroxycinnamic acid (alpha-CHCA): 10 mg/mL in 50:50 ACN:H2O / 0.1% TFA

maldi_ms.calibrant: Bovine serum albumin (BSA, 66.5 kDa, Mann Research Laboratories)

sample_prep.spotting: 0.5 uL matrix pre-spotted and dried, then 1:1 matrix:acidified sample overlay

zipTip_cleanup.protocol: Wet 50% ACN/0.1% TFA x5; equilibrate 0.1% TFA x5; bind 20 cycles; wash 0.1% TFA x3; elute in matrix

lc_ms_ms.application: Proteomic identification of tryptic peptides from cytochrome C
lc_ms_ms.trypsin: Sequencing grade modified trypsin (Promega, Madison, WI)

basic_blocks.label: main
basic_blocks.content: Bead preparation, device loading, wash, sample merge, active incubation, separation, QC detect
